title: CanvasDaemon Test Classic Quiz
module: Module 2: How AI Learns from Data
description: Test quiz created through CanvasDaemon. Keep unpublished.

questions.question_text: Which of these is an example of AI?
questions.correct_comments: A recommendation system is an example of AI because it uses data patterns to suggest items.
questions.incorrect_comments: Look for the option that uses data and prediction to make a recommendation.

questions.objective: Explain that AI systems can learn from data.
questions.question_text: AI systems can learn patterns from data.
questions.correct_comments: Correct. Many AI systems learn patterns from examples or data.
questions.incorrect_comments: AI systems often improve by finding patterns in data.

questions.question_text: Select all examples that can involve AI.
questions.correct_comments: Chatbots, recommendation systems, and image classifiers can all involve AI.
questions.incorrect_comments: Choose the options that use prediction, classification, or pattern recognition.

questions.objective: Identify data as a key input for AI training.
questions.correct_comments: Correct. AI models learn patterns from data or training data.
questions.incorrect_comments: The missing word is what AI models use to learn patterns.
